metadata.description: Skills that teach Claude to write, review and debug React the way senior React engineers do, plus a tool that finds where your app is slow, fixes the re-renders that cause it, and proves the speed-up.

plugins.name: react-best-practices
plugins.description: React best-practice skills: re-renders and composition, memoization, reconciliation and keys, component API design, context, effects and cleanup, refs and closures, layout and portals, data fetching, error handling, interaction responsiveness (INP), large lists and virtualization, loading performance (bundles, code splitting, images, fonts, Core Web Vitals), and animation.

plugins.name: react-render-audit
plugins.description: Find where a real React or Next.js app is slow and fix the re-renders that cause it, without changing behavior: /optimize-renders times a user flow first on mobile and desktop profiles, ranks re-render causes by the time they cost in the slow steps, fixes them with the react-best-practices skills, and keeps a fix only if behavior stayed identical and a timing benchmark shows the slow step got faster. When nothing is slow, it says so and changes nothing.
